name: OpenPoseidon Tidewater Wildlife
description: Tidewater's humpback whale (dgreenheck/tidewater, MIT) as the animal OP_TidewaterHumpback: it cruises deep water, surfaces to blow, breaches, slaps its flippers and dives fluke-up; it can be shot; and Tidewater's sea sounds (CC0 recordings): surf, gulls, the boat's engine and hull, the whale. Spawn it from the dev panel's Zeus tab.
